answer_1.quote: We focus on the task of generating dialog responses r using the dialogue context c and an external knowledge base K.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our model with several common metrics. We measure the word-overlapping based relevance using BLEU-1/2 , ROUGE-1/2 , and METEOR . We measure the contextual embedding similarity using BertScore . We measure the diversity with the ratio of unique unigrams or bigrams among generated sentences .

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation where we ask annotators to indicate their preferences between our best performing models from both the retrieval and the generative settings, and a model without knowledge enhancement.
answer_4.guideline: We evaluated each each model response using three metrics: Fluency indicating whether the sentence is grammatically correct and natural; Coherence indicating whether the response is on topic and relevant to the dialogue history; Reflectiveness indicating if the response summarizes what the client has said or interprets what the client means. All these metrics are scored with a three-point Likert scale.
